documents.name: CloudEngine Specification
documents.text: CloudEngine is an automated deployment framework designed by Knowledge Graph Labs. It uses generative configuration templates to provision server clusters. The system was architected by Dhruv Mittal, who led the development team in San Francisco. CloudEngine integrates with Neo4j to build network dependency graphs, preventing routing circularity.

documents.name: Knowledge Graph Venture Overview
documents.text: Knowledge Graph Labs was established in 2022 to build developer workflow tools. The venture is backed by TechCapital Partners, who led a $10 million Series A round. Their core product is CodeSync, a cloud synchronizer. CodeSync's team includes engineers previously at AWS and Microsoft, working under the technical leadership of Dhruv Mittal.

documents.name: Project Orion Brief
documents.text: Project Orion is a data platform being built by Knowledge Graph Labs for Meridian Health. Priya Raman leads the Orion engineering team and reports to Dhruv Mittal. Amit Verma works on Orion's ingestion pipeline, which runs on Apache Kafka. The project is delivered from the company's Bengaluru office.

documents.name: Meridian Health Partnership
documents.text: Meridian Health is a hospital network headquartered in Singapore. In 2024 Meridian Health signed a three-year partnership with Knowledge Graph Labs to modernise its patient records. The agreement covers Project Orion and a CodeSync licence for Meridian's internal developers.

documents.name: Team Directory
documents.text: Priya Raman joined Knowledge Graph Labs in 2023 after working at Google. Amit Verma is a data engineer who previously built streaming systems at Flipkart. Both are based in Bengaluru. Sara Lee manages partnerships at TechCapital Partners and sits on the Knowledge Graph Labs board.
